summary: Polestar filed a Form 6-K reporting a USD 400 million term loan credit facility from Geely Sweden Automotive Investment AB (GSAI), an affiliate. The facility comprises a USD 100 million committed USD term loan and a USD 300 million uncommitted RMB-denominated loan, available until September 30, 2026, with a 365-day maturity. GSAI holds an option to convert principal and interest into ADSs at a 5-day VWAP-based price. The loan is unsecured and subordinated to existing club facilities. This is routine financing, not a special situation; no strategic event, tender, or restructuring is involved.
